items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: He went to the conservatory too in Boston.

ctx.x: And we corresponded and we corresponded. Well he had no eyes for marriage at all. Because he wanted to get a degree in music. Well to make a long story short, he got a degree in music.
He went to the conservatory too in Boston.
Yes. He got his degree in music. When we come to New York, Zutty's still playing drums and Jerome is working in the Welfare Department.
